blocks.text: Memorabilia and clothing belonging to French screen icon Brigitte Bardot were auctioned at Paris’s Hotel Drouot on Sept. 21, 2026, with organizers weighing several titles for the sale inspired by places associated with her life. “You find yourself among the various places where Brigitte Bardot lived. We move between La Madrague, La Garrigue, Bazoches and then Rue de la Tour, where she grew up,” auctioneer Alexandre Millon says. ” Brigitte wouldn’t have hesitated to sell all her possessions so that they could benefit the animals,” adds Bruno Jacquelin, representing the foundation created by the actress.
